title: Magnetic Force Between Two Balls
summary: Rick has n baskets at specific positions, and Morty must place m balls into these baskets to maximize the minimum distance between any two balls.
statement: Rick has n baskets at specific positions, and Morty must place m balls into these baskets to maximize the minimum distance between any two balls. The distance between any two balls at positions x and y is calculated as |x - y|. Given the positions array and the number of balls, determine the maximum minimum distance.
constraints: Place m balls in distinct basket positions.
Maximize the minimum distance between every pair of placed balls.
hints: For a candidate distance, greedily place the first ball leftmost and each later ball at the earliest feasible basket.
The leftmost greedy placement leaves maximal room for all remaining balls, making feasibility monotone.
editorial: The leftmost greedy placement leaves maximal room for all remaining balls, making feasibility monotone.

tests.explanation: Placing balls at one, four, and seven makes the minimum distance three.
Using the extreme positions yields distance 999,999,999.
